prompt.en: Explain how developments during the Early Harappan stage led to the Mature Harappan cities. State three different factors.

label.en: Farming grew stronger through copper tools, fertile river plains, two crops from one field and check dams, which gave more food than people needed at once

level1.en: Farming intensified long before the mature cities existed. What changed in the fields and the water supply that let one harvest feed more people than before?

clue.en: Copper tools on the fertile plains, two crops from one field at Kalibangan and check dams (gabarbands) all helped people produce more food.

level2Template.en: Farming improved through copper tools, check dams and growing two crops on one field, which gave a food ___.

label.en: Crafts improved and were made on a large scale: pottery, semi-precious stone beads, shell bangles and copper work

level1.en: Beads, pottery, shell bangles - which of these were already being made at scale, long before any mature city stood?

clue.en: Regional pottery, stone beads (at Harappa, Kunal and Datrana), shell bangles and copper work all developed slowly.

level2Template.en: Workshops improved crafts such as regional pottery, shell bangles and semi-precious stone ___ at sites like Harappa, Kunal and Datrana.

label.en: Regions became linked through trade, and early seals and marks on pots could be forerunners of the later seals and script

level1.en: Goods were moving between regions, and potters were marking their pots. What was linking these regions together?

clue.en: Early seals and graffiti on pots could be forerunners of the later seals and script, and goods such as shell moved between regions.

level2Template.en: Regions were linked by ___, and early seals and marks on pots could be forerunners of the later seals and script.

text.en: The Mature cities grew out of three main developments during the Early Harappan stage.
Farming improved through copper tools, check dams and growing two crops on one field, which gave a food ___.
Workshops improved crafts such as regional pottery, shell bangles and semi-precious stone ___ at sites like Harappa, Kunal and Datrana.
Regions were linked by ___, and early seals and marks on pots could be forerunners of the later seals and script.
